title: Canonical coefficient transpose agrees with direct compactification realization
statement: For l,E,D,o,d,rec as in [def-sf-integral-expression-recursion-data] and a prescribed direct comparison dc with its open/proper normalization and finite projection conditions, the canonicalComparisons of [lem-sf-integral-expression-transpose-is-iso] satisfies SupportAgreement(d,dc). Explicitly its component on the single-variable supportExpression f cf, composed with the recorded integral compact-support realization, equals dc.comparison(f,cf).hom at every object of basicSupportDomain. This only identifies that compactification expression, not arbitrary trees or structural generators.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; agent-formulated expression-tree refinement, lem-sf-integral-expression-recursion, proof steps 1--11.

proof.text: Apply the compactSupport and variable clauses of canonicalComparisons_equations to supportInput(f,cf,K). The defining conjunctions of basicSupportDomain give this expression-domain witness. Expand the unaryA transports for the hidden open and proper arrows.

At the open arrow use naturality of the primitive comparison at the actual input unit and the triangle identity. Since Reconstruction makes the relevant units and counits invertible, cancel them. unary_spec identifies the resulting hom with L(model.openReduction)_K followed by the inverse actual unit at the integral open extension. At proper image use unary_spec and naturality of model.push at the counit to cancel the transported reconstruction unit. The remaining proper hom is model.push at the open system J_j(R K). Thus the tree component equals exactly the first two factors of DirectNormalization.

Compose that equality with the published sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization hom. Apply dc.normalization, an equality of the specified whole-system maps, to obtain SupportAgreement. No new appeal to finite evaluation or a tower-limit uniqueness theorem is required: DirectComparisons already includes that normalization and every finite projection.
